concerns.location: research.md:§2 Dataset Strategy table; plan.md Phase 1 T013d1
concerns.text: All three cited parquets are described only as generic 'DFT-computed records' with no evidence they contain 2D material structures or 6-component elastic tensors. The question requires 2D materials with complete elastic tensors (FR-001, Principle VI, SC-001); the plan's own fallback ('if none contains the required fields, the pipeline exits with an explicit dataset-mismatch error') concedes the primary source may be the WRONG dataset. If none of the three parquets carries structure/CIF + elastic_tensor fields for 2D entries, the entire pipeline cannot run and SC-001 is unachievable. The plan should document, per source, the expected schema/field names and whether 2D entries with elastic tensors are plausibly present (e.g. by inspecting the dataset card or a sample of rows at planning time), rather than deferring all dataset-fit validation to runtime failure.

concerns.location: research.md:§2 'Alternate canonical source (if primary lacks required fields)'
concerns.text: The fallback chain across three different HuggingFace repositories sits in tension with spec §4 'single, verified public repository per run (no mixing sources)' and constitution Principle I ('fetched from the same canonical source on every run'). As written, different runs could silently use different datasets depending on runtime field checks, breaking run-to-run reproducibility of the data. Pin ONE primary source and its checksum; if a fallback is kept, specify that the chosen source + checksum is recorded per run and that the selection is deterministic given the pinned schema-validation outcome.
